2.23.1 Tablix.Name
Applies to RDL 2008/01, RDL 2010/01, and RDL 2016/01
The Tablix.Name attribute specifies a unique identifier for a Tablix. This attribute MUST be specified
and its value MUST be a NormalizedString that is a case-sensitive CLS-compliant identifier
[UTR15] that is unique among report items and scope names.
Following is the parent element of the Tablix.Name attribute.
Parent elements
Tablix
The following is the XML Schema definition of the Tablix.Name attribute.
 <xsd:attribute name="Name" type="xsd:normalizedString" use="required" />
